intro: Our Upmods Electra gives your space a soft glow. With its lit-up headboard and hidden storage, it’s designed for those who want both function and finesse.

features.title: Engineered for everyday strength
features.text: Our engineered wood frame gives you dependable support and structure, crafted to last through daily use.

features.title: Storage that sits right behind you
features.text: The headboard includes a hidden storage space—perfect for tucking away books, chargers, or bedside essentials.

features.title: A ledge that works as hard as you do
features.text: With an integrated display shelf and grommet hole, you can charge devices or place décor without clutter.

features.title: Comfort built into every layer
features.text: The cushioned headboard adds soft support for sitting up—ideal for late-night reads or morning coffee moments.

features.title: Lift-up storage, made effortless
features.text: A spacious underbed box lifts easily with built-in support—so you can keep your room tidy without breaking a sweat. And with multiple storage options available, you can choose what works best for your home and lifestyle.

name: Upmods Electra King Size Engineered Wood Bed With Box Storage
